messages:
Aisha (CSM): quick sync — AcuHealth has 3 repeat incidents this week (2x 503 on inference, 1x slow cold-start). Renewals conversation in 3 weeks. we need clear ownership + mitigation plan. who can take the action items?
Tom (Support): I can own the customer-facing updates and runbook. already opened a ticket and pinged infra.
Ben (SRE): I can own the root-cause for the 503s. preliminary look: KV cache eviction thrash + retry storm on concentrated load windows.
Lena (CS Ops): I can track action items and update renewal risk score. can you both add ETA for fixes? cc: @account-team :eyes:
Tom (Support): ETA for customer comms: EOD today with interim mitigation (rate-limit recommendation + temporary model fallback).
Ben (SRE): Root-cause RCA ETA: 48h. Plan: 1) guardrails on client retry behavior 2) temporary route to lower-concurrency Dedicated pool 3) tune cache TTL.
support-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3479 for AcuHealth repeat 503s — assigned to Ben (SRE). Link: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-3479 :white_check_mark:
Aisha (CSM): thanks. Tom — please include the suggested fallback model id and exact curl sample so customers can apply quickly.
Tom (Support): adding sample now:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDBOX" \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-small-1", "input":"<prompt>"}'
```
Tom (Support): note in comms: recommend client-side backoff 500ms + jitter (exponential) and a single retry.
Ben (SRE): I pushed a temporary routing policy to send AcuHealth traffic to dedicated-pool-3 during their daily batch window. monitoring for 2hrs.
Lena (CS Ops): recording action items: [Tom] customer update EOD, [Ben] RCA + routing fix (48h), [Aisha] renewal risk update and exec brief. I'll add assignees in the tracker.
Aisha (CSM): also capture feedback: AcuHealth requested more visible retry guidance in docs and an SLA note for 503s. add to product feedback board.
Ben (SRE): quick log snippet from the 503s:
```
2026-03-18T14:12:08Z ERROR request_id=abc123 status=503 model=redwood-3 kv_cache_evicted=true concurrent_requests=128
2026-03-18T14:12:08Z WARN retry_attempt=1 request_id=abc123
```
Ben (SRE): adding mitigations to INC-2026-3479. will update thread with RCA.
Tom (Support): :thumbsup: i'll file the comms draft and share here for signoff.
Aisha (CSM): perfect. can we have a short sync tomorrow 10am to confirm RCA and customer message? if Ben/Tom ok, i'll block calendar and invite stakeholders.
Ben (SRE): 10am works.
Tom (Support): works for me.
Lena (CS Ops): added calendar invite and updated renewal risk as "elevated" until resolved.
Aisha (CSM): thanks team. goal: close action items before next renewal touch (3 weeks). I'll prepare exec brief once RCA is in.
support-bot: Reminder: INC-2026-3479 status changed to "investigating" (Ben).
